mapper.select: SELECT user_id, auth_provider, social_id, login_id, email, nickname, profile_image_url, introduce, github_username, role, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, auth_provider, social_id, login_id, password, email, nickname, profile_image_url, github_username, role, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( auth_provider, social_id, login_id, password, email, nickname, profile_image_url, github_username, role, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{authProvider}, #{socialId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{githubUsername}, 'USER', NOW(), NOW() )
